prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1186; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the scene in Pasadena, Texas, I found two vehicles involved in a rear-end collision in the right lane of the roadway. Driver 2 was stopped in traffic when the front of Driver 1's vehicle struck the rear of Driver 2's vehicle. Driver 1 stated the vehicle ahead slowed suddenly and that they were unable to stop in time. Driver 2 reported no prior issues with the vehicle. Both vehicles sustained visible rear and front damage and were drivable from the scene, though the vehicles were towed due to damage to the rear bumper assembly of Driver 2's vehicle. A passenger in Driver 1's vehicle remained seated and was not injured. Driver 1 complained of neck and back strain and declined transport by ambulance but stated they would seek medical evaluation. Driver 2 reported no injury. Weather was clear and the pavement was dry. Citation issued to Driver 1 for failure to control speed. Photographs taken and witness statements collected at the scene.
